correctness.rationale: From explicit enumeration of two independently sampled co-players derive P_C−P_D=A=a+C0(q²−omega z²) and P_S−P_D=B=A−k+2C0 omega z y, with h=1−rho, q=rho+h(x+z), a=rc/3−c<0, C0=Lh. At every strictly interior equilibrium A=B=0, derivative of reduced replicator vector field gives trJ=2C0 y[hq(x+z)+omega z(1−3z)] and detJ=4C0² omega xyz(hq y−omega z²), independently rederived symbolically. det<0 gives saddle; if det≥0 then omega z²≤h q y; for z≤1/3 trace positive, and z>1/3 trace bracket ≥ hq/z[(2z−1)²+x(4z−1)]>0, so no interior LAS even when det=0. On CD edge increasing selection gradient forbids interior sink; CS edge B−A=−k excludes its interior; DS quadratic B0(z) with positive initial derivative gives at most one attracting root. Two vertices C,D possible; all-S unstable because C invasion k>0. Exact admissible witness (33/20,1,2,1/2,3/25,3/4) has stable C and D and DS z=4/5 with negative transverse/tangent eigenvalues, DS z=1/5 saddle, attaining 3. Finite rational checks corroborate but are not all-parameter proof.
residual_risks: Result concerns LAS equilibria only, not global attractors, periodic cycles, stochastic finite populations or N>3.
